# #190 — Fix openbrain-memory enum ref collision for status fields

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-06-21T05:53:34Z
Updated: 2026-06-21T16:01:31Z
Closed: 2026-06-21T16:01:31Z

---

## Problem
Skippy's Hermes 0.17/OpenBrain-required runtime is operational, but recent gateway logs still show dynamic OpenBrain tool-schema injection failing:

```text
Open Brain tool schema build failed:
openbrain-memory tool schema conversion failed:
$: conflicting enum reference 'status'
```

Read-only tracing points to the openbrain-memory package converter:

```text
python/openbrain-memory/src/openbrain_memory/schema.py
tool_contracts_to_tool_schemas(...)
_collect_manifest_enum_refs(...)
_merge_enum_refs(...)
```

The converter appears to collect enum refs globally by bare field name. The OB contract has more than one `status` enum, for example `lane_load.status` and `lane_upsert.status`. The values can match while the converted schema context differs enough for `_merge_enum_refs(...)` to treat the bare `status` ref as conflicting.

## Desired behavior
`openbrain-memory` schema conversion should not use a global bare-field-name enum ref that collides across tools/paths.

Likely acceptable fixes:

- scope enum refs by tool/path, not only by field name
- or merge identical enum definitions safely when values/shape are equivalent
- or avoid global enum ref extraction for OpenAI tool schema emission when local inline enums are safer

## Non-goals
This is not an mcp2cli issue. Hermes OpenBrain memory is using the built-in HTTP provider path:

```text
memory.provider=openbrain
transport=http
required OpenBrain-only mode
```

Local `mcp2cli` is unrelated to this warning.

## Runtime evidence
Skippy after upgrade:

```text
Hermes Agent v0.17.0
Gateway active
Memory provider: openbrain
Required mode: OpenBrain only
Plugin installed/status available
Open Brain hosted health healthy
```

So the provider is usable, but dynamic OB tool schema injection is still dirty.
